verdict.reasons: The image correctly features the authorized white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton roll with authentic, legible branding matching the required style. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present and correctly formatted. The setting appropriately depicts an agricultural crop bed with neutral small seedlings, which aligns with the article's context of drip tape installation and emitter spacing. There are no core defects such as mixed product families, fake logos, or impossible geometry. Minor details such as the coiled tape next to the roll are consistent with the product presentation and do not detract from the overall quality.

focused_physical_review.reason: Visual inspection of the package base reveals a dark line emerging directly from the side of the required AFP package and extending to the ground. Because the line touches the package and disappears at its base rather than being separated by soil, clear_soil_gap is false and line_touches_or_crosses_package is true. The single coiled section on the ground is connected to this line and is considered part of the continuous product, so there is no extra_loose_product_coil. The carton sides and base appear clean with no protruding white ribbon or tape tails.
